notes: Checked main nav, per-category mega-menu dropdowns (Furniture/Lighting/Kitchen & Dining/Decor/Storage/Bedroom/Bathroom/Outdoor/Lifestyle/For Kids), and footer. Every category dropdown's 'Bestsellers' item links to the SAME URL (relative href 'design-best-sellers') - confirmed by diffing all 10 occurrences in the homepage HTML, byte-identical. No genuine per-category Bestsellers sub-listing exists on this site; it is a single undifferentiated bestsellers PLP branded 'Design best-sellers' ('Get ready to meet our bestsellers... there's just something extra special about our bestsellers. Get in on the hype and discover your very own design all-star!'). Site is a Vue SPA over a PHP backend (per prior Home-Decor pass notes) so category/listing pages render only a skeleton loader server-side; the product count is injected client-side. Confirmed the site's own catalog-products JSON API (successfully used in the prior Home-Decor pass for regular category totals) does NOT recognize '/design-best-sellers' as a filterable 'uri' param - it silently falls back to the whole-catalogue total (22917), the exact locale-prefix/unknown-uri trap documented in the prior pass - so that API was not usable here. Used Playwright (tier 2) with a standard desktop Chrome UA to render the page directly (no Cloudflare interstitial encountered) and read the DOM text, which shows '424 products' directly above the product grid, matching the site's own i18n string template 'products.PRODUCTS_COUNT': '1 product|:count products' fetched live from the site's translation API in the same page load. No other Bestsellers-type URL/label (e.g. Top Sellers, Popular, Trending) found anywhere in nav/footer/sitemap search.

rows.evidence: Playwright-rendered DOM text '424 products' directly above the product grid on /en-us/design-best-sellers; page heading 'Design best-sellers' / 'Get ready to meet our bestsellers'
